title: It’s a good buy and good quality.
text: It’s a good buy and good quality.. I love this spice rack organizer.  Have purchased 2 so far.  I have a small kitchen, and this is the greatest little organizer.  I put spices, pill bottles and every little thing I use every day.  And they don’t hog up my kitchen counter-fit nicely on side of refrigerator.

product_metadata.title: Magnetic Spice Rack Organizer Refrigerator Spice Storage Shelf（Red 2 pack with hook）
features: ✅Awesome Spice Rack: Made of high-quality thick steel, it is durable and has super-strong magnets on the back. The surface is treated with black matte finish. It fits perfectly into your kitchen.

✅ Easy to Use; No drilling or assembly required. The magnet is remarkably strong, it can bear 5 pounds. Easy to be attached to the side of refrigerator or other iron surfaces. Would not gradually slide down the fridge.

✅ Wide range of use: Eased up your cabinet space and made your spices and extracts easier to find. It is a very good storage rack, suitable for spices, pepper, salt, sugar, Jar of olive oil, cooking oils, pepper, or other small things.
✅ Size and Weight: 9.7" L x 4.35" W x 3.4" H; 1.7 pounds.
